main: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity GAME BOX Chinese PWA voice chat design board with exactly THREE complete mobile screens side by side, each 390x844 logical aspect ratio, no clipping, large 1800x1400 landscape canvas. Reference image is existing GAME BOX visual identity: pastel pink sky arcade scenery, white readable surfaces, original friendly lime-green cube mascot wearing headphones, glossy small toy icons, coral primary pill buttons, soft lavender accents, rounded cards. Preserve this identity, no third party characters. NOT a technical wireframe. Three screens labelled above outside phones: 01 语聊大厅; 02 语聊房间; 03 创建房间. All important text crisp simplified Chinese. First screen: light compact illustrated header 语聊开黑, subtitle 找好友，一起聊, coral 创建房间 button; two tabs 好友房 / 房间邀请 with small invite badge 2. A room code entry small outlined button 输入房间码. Two-column 4 pastel illustrated room cards with distinct generic cube/robot/music art, room names 午后游戏局, 欢乐开黑, 新手集合, 周末闲聊, small host avatars, truthful illustrative member occupancy e.g. 4/8, small badge 好友可见. Bottom nav 首页 语聊 消息 我的 with 语聊 selected coral. No public popularity rankings or category tabs. Second screen: room page 午后游戏局, back arrow and more menu, small 好友房 · 4/8人 and status 语音已连接. Upper third eight numbered circular mic seats in 2 rows of4, three occupied by green cube/blue robot/star avatars and rest empty +; show host badge 房主, one speaking outline plus tiny waveform, one mute icon. White/light lavender open space, not dark nightclub. Below: compact game association card 南方十三张 and button 查看游戏. Text chat area heading 房间聊天 with two short sample messages and entry announcement. Above bottom composer a status pill 当前仅收听 and coral 申请上麦, 邀请好友 secondary. Bottom text composer 说点什么… and 发送. NO global bottom nav inside room. Third screen: white create form same pastel decorative compact header, back arrow 创建房间. 房间名称 input 小方的游戏房; 关联游戏 picker 南方十三张 with icon and chevron; 房间可见性 two selectable cards 好友房 (好友可加入) and 私密房 (凭邀请或房间码加入). 上麦需审批 toggle on with helper 开启后由房主或管理员批准. small capacity helper 最多8人 · 8个麦位 (sample configured capacity). Bottom coral 创建并进入. All screens fill height gracefully with safe areas. Sample names/numbers illustrative only. Avoid gift shops, payments, livestream metrics, fake KTV controls, pig mascots.

states: Use case ui-mockup. Design GAME BOX voice room interaction states board, EXACTLY four full mobile screens side by side with titles above outside phones 08 成员操作, 09 麦克风权限, 10 离开房间, 11 连接异常. Match reference soft pink sky arcade, original lime-green cube headphones mascot, light lavender room, white rounded bottom sheets, coral pill buttons, readable dark simplified Chinese. Complete full phone boundaries, landscape board 2400x1400, no cropped phone. Room backdrop in each: title 午后游戏局, 8 circular seats 2 rows of4 with toy avatars, subtle white chat, bottom text input. Screen08: large bottom sheet titled 成员操作 with avatar 小星 UID 100028, room moderator view grouped rows 允许上麦, 移下麦位, 禁止发言, 移出房间; lower subdued 举报 / 屏蔽此人. Do not show all actions as simultaneously enabled: 允许上麦 muted disabled when already seated; role-dependent view sample. Screen09: bottom sheet with friendly green cube holding tiny microphone, title 开启麦克风, text 开启后才能发言，暂不开启也能收听和文字聊天, coral 允许使用麦克风 and subtle 暂时旁听. This is app explanation not fake system OS dialog, no fabricated permission grant switches. Screen10: centered white confirmation modal over softly dimmed room, title 离开房间？, text 离开后将断开语音连接, buttons 再聊一会 / 确认离开. Screen11: full room with amber modest banner 语音连接已断开, secondary 文字聊天仍可用, coral small 重新连接. All microphone publishing controls disabled with label 语音未连接, while text input enabled. This illustrates RTC-only disconnection, not total network outage. Lower area has clear states row or helper small 本次重连不会自动开启麦克风. No global bottom nav on any room screen. No gift icons, no monetization, no third party characters. High fidelity polished consistent UI.
